snippet.title: Daily SaaS Start Up Grind - Utilizing AI (Claude Code)
snippet.description:
📌 Try Claude Code here → http://clau.de/kevinpark

In today’s video, I share a real story from within our SaaS startup — how we ran into a compliance crisis that nearly cost us a big customer, and how we solved it using AI (Anthropic’s Claude Code).

As a founder, you’re constantly balancing product development, customer demands, and limited engineering resources. Sometimes, a single issue can feel like it’s make-or-break. For us, that issue was related to compliance — specifically, the ability for freight companies to customize detailed driving-time rules for their drivers. Although our product was built to ensure customers were well within the regulatory requirements, this particular customer wanted to get even more detailed with their operation.

This was a big challenge — and the solution required new UI, new logic, and a lot of code changes. In this video, I bring you behind the scenes and walk you through the problem, how our engineering team tackled it, and how Claude Code accelerated the process.

💡 If you’re building a SaaS, running a startup, or just curious about how AI can help in real-world workflows, this video will give you a behind-the-scenes look at how founders actually solve crises.

snippet.description:

Then it runs them through a few Hormozi sales frameworks I saved into a folder on my machine, and drops a coaching doc into Notion for each call. Key moments, talk ratio, scorecard, action items. All filled in before I've had coffee.

The whole thing is one skill and one routine. I built it in under 10 minutes with Claude Code. No n8n, no Zapier, no flowcharts.

snippet.title: Is your backend actually garbage? #coding #csmajor
snippet.description:
👇Vibe coding can hide a terrible backend 

A clean frontend can fool you. When you prompt your way to a working app, the AI optimizes for “does it run” and not whether it’s secure, scalable, or maintainable. That polished UI might be hiding exposed API keys, zero input validation, and business logic sitting in the client where anyone can read it. 

It works in the demo and falls apart the second a real user touches it. This is exactly why CS fundamentals still matter: anyone can generate the frontend now, but knowing what’s broken underneath is the skill that separates a vibe coder from a software engineer.

#computerscience #programming #csmajor #vibecoding #learntocode

👨🏻‍💻 About Operations Kevin:
I’m that odd person that's passionate about operations. I have the privilege of working on high-impact products and leading large-scale operations.

📍 How I Got Here:

- Graduated with a degree in aerospace engineering and started my career in aerospace manufacturing. 

- Worked on sweet products such as SpaceX’s Falcon 9 engine and Boeing’s LEAP engine.

- Transitioned into tech, joining Amazon as an operations manager. Led teams of 600+ at a last-mile delivery station. 

- Pivoted to program management and worked on Amazon’s machine learning-based hiring and recruitment efforts. Led a team of 5 program managers building software tools for large-scale hiring.

- Joined Apple as an iPhone ops program manager. Managed capacity & volume planning for iPhone SE, 11, 12, 13, and 14. 

- Drove strategic roadmap planning for future iPhone products, working with engineering, manufacturing, business ops, and finance teams.

Today: 
Left it all behind to pursue entrepreneurship. Currently scaling two businesses and consulting small businesses in industries that I’m passionate about.

snippet.title: The exact Reddit system behind 11 million views and $30K MRR
snippet.description:
This app makes $34K/month and most of it came from Reddit.

Romàn didn’t run ads. He didn’t buy influencers. He just posted on Reddit.

Here’s the playbook he used to turn it into a real revenue channel:

Find the subreddits where your customers already hang out
Post like a member, not a marketer
Lead with a story or a problem, not a pitch
Use templates that don’t trip the spam filters
Handle haters in the comments instead of deleting them
Turn every viral thread into a repeatable format

Learn how to start an LLC in California, step by step. From choosing your LLC name to keeping it in good standing, this is your guide.
✅ Northwest Registered Agent (Best Deal): https://meticsmedia.com/northwest-4QC

Starting an LLC in California is more straightforward than most people think, and this guide walks you through the entire process from start to finish, step by step. I show you exactly how to choose a compliant California LLC name, use the bizfile Online business name search, and check for trademarks before you commit.

From there, I explain what a registered agent is, why most people use a service instead of doing it themselves, and why Northwest Registered Agent is the option I recommend. Then I walk you through the full Northwest filing process screen by screen, including how to get your EIN, what the optional add-ons actually mean, and which ones make sense for most beginners.

We also cover creating your operating agreement, opening a business bank account, and what California specifically requires to keep your LLC in good standing each year. That includes the California Annual Franchise Tax and the Statement of Information.

snippet.title: Student built a medical AI app in 2 weeks with no coding experience
snippet.description:
Cedric is a college student. 7 weeks after launching PepAI, he’d done $50K in total revenue, with $11K MRR and almost 2,000 active subscriptions.

The stack:
Replit for vibe coding the app
Claude as his “senior developer” for anything he didn’t know how to set up
Firebase for the backend + user data
RevenueCat for in-app subscriptions ($45/yr or $10/mo with a 3-day trial)
Resend for email

The hardest part wasn’t building it. It was getting past Apple review (they kept rejecting it for medical advice). Once he found the workaround, it sailed through.
